record_title: SDPI template for robust counterexamples to a proposed relay-capacity characterization
provenance: A structural extension of the recent binary relay-channel counterexample, replacing its fixed BSC pair by arbitrary product component channels and an input-free post-processing contraction coefficient.
limitations: Restricted to a split product relay architecture and to the specific proposed DF/C-CF/U-CF characterization in arXiv:2609.15709. The contraction bound is sufficient rather than generally tight, and there is material folklore/near-simultaneous priority risk because the motivating counterexample is recent and the abstraction is concise.
